biomarkers.name: IDH2 R172 mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defining molecular feature of many SNUC; potential IDH inhibitor clinical trial relevance

biomarkers.name: SMARCB1 (INI-1)
biomarkers.prevalence: Retained in true SNUC; loss defines separate entity
biomarkers.clinical_use: Distinguish SNUC from SMARCB1-deficient sinonasal carcinoma

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Nests/sheets of medium-sized undifferentiated cells with high nuclear-cytoplasmic ratio, prominent nucleoli, mitoses, necrosis
variants: IDH2-mutant subset (may be a distinct entity)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: High-grade by definition; no differentiation lineage identifiable

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Uncertain — proposed sinonasal progenitor/stem cells with dedifferentiation
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Undifferentiated — diagnosis of exclusion after ruling out other sinonasal entities (SNEC, NUT carcinoma, olfactory neuroblastoma, SMARCB1-deficient)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: IDH2-mutant subset may represent a distinct epigenetically dysregulated entity
